_about: Public-domain Luke Milbourne, High Church rector of St Ethelburga's, London, for the Word Hoard: Mysteries in Religion Vindicated, The Christian Pattern Paraphrased, his metrical Psalms of David, his catechism, his many sermons on obedience and on the thirtieth of January, his pamphlets against Hoadly, The Royal Martyr Lamented, and A Legacy to the Church of England. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 124 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
